responsibility: Implements the path-sensitive diagnostics machinery that turns diagnostic_path event sequences into printable and machine-readable structure. It provides event-meaning stringification for SARIF, path classification such as interprocedural detection, textual path summarization and control-flow visualization with label/link effects, and extensive selftests, making it the core execution-path rendering and analysis backend used by rich_location-attached paths.
same_name_distinction: Within the diagnostic-path pair, this file is the implementation side: unlike gcc/diagnostic-path.h, which defines the abstract event/path interfaces, it provides the operational logic for path analysis and rendering, including SARIF meaning stringification, interprocedural checks, text/control-flow visualization, and selftests.
